name: OpenDose external validation corpus
description: Datasets whose correct analysis results were published independently of OpenDose (NIST certified values, R reference outputs, package test suites, peer-reviewed papers, GraphPad and G*Power manuals). See README.md for conventions.

conventions.tolerance: abs = half a unit in the last printed digit unless stated; rel = relative; abs 0 for exact integers
conventions.printed: the reference value exactly as printed in the source, when it was transcribed from text
conventions.derived: values computed from printed numbers (re-parameterisations); not references
conventions.reference_status: present only when the source is internally inconsistent or not exactly reproducible; such entries are not pass/fail gates
conventions.model_dependent / approximate: reference depends on a fitting choice or simulation; compare loosely
